ns2:section.sectionText: . Registration restricted to Finance, Actuarial Science, 1st Stage Accountancy majors thru November 13th. Dual degree students who are declared Accountancy will NOT receive registration priority. On November 14th, any remaining seats will open to other College of Business; Actuarial Science students at approximately noon. On November 28th, any remaining seats will be closed and seat limits will be set below the number of registered students. Registered students who drop the course can request to reregister for the dropped section, space permitting. Prerequisite (FIN 221) will be enforced. Students who have not completed FIN 221 will be removed from FIN 300
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Curric Unassigned or Accountancy or Finance or Actuarial Science or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management major(s).
